title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, U. Of California on 1982-05-22
lineage: Sbd Mcassette > DAT > CDR > CDR >  EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of a high‑energy early‑80s Greek Theatre show, highlighted by smoking first‑set classics and a soaring China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider jam.
ai_review.review: The recording is a solid soundboard tape with clear instrumentation and only minor level fluctuations, making the performance easy to enjoy. The band delivers an incendiary set – Jack Straw into Sugaree, a tight Lazy Lightning→Supplication, and a blazing China Cat Sunflower → Rider that leads into a memorable Not Fade Away and Women Are Smarter. Overall the show is praised for its tight playing, high energy, and standout moments despite a few isolated criticisms.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 30 reviews overwhelmingly rate the show 4‑5 stars, praising both musical performance and sound quality; only a handful of low or neutral scores are outliers.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Most reviewers call it crisp, clear and excellent for a 1982 tape; a few note minor level swings, slight tape hiss and lack of normalization but nothing that detracts from listening.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: A tight, fire‑starter first set with seamless segues; the second set builds momentum with jam highlights (China→Rider, NFA) and closes on a high note.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s vocals are repeatedly praised as strong and his guitar tone is described as ‘smoking’ and “tight”.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass is noted for clarity in the mix and occasional ‘bombs’, with listeners appreciating a solid low‑end presence.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir’s vocal performance gets mixed notes – some find it fine, others call it a bit sloppy; his penny‑whistle work in Space is highlighted positively.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland receives kudos for soulful ‘Good Times Blues’, “Never Trust a Woman”, and vocal reverb that adds depth.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann’s drumming is described as tight and solid; occasional comments note the drums being cut in the mix but overall steady.
